_comment: Benign console output that must not fail `pnpm shot`. Only console `error` and `warning` lines are checked. An entry matches a line when `pattern` (a JavaScript RegExp, unanchored unless the pattern anchors itself) matches the message text AND (`type` is absent OR equals the console message type, e.g. 'warning', 'error', 'debug'). Seeded from the Task 1 spike baseline on the Vite dev server: 10 runs (5 cases x webgpu|webgl) on three 0.187.0 produced no warnings or errors, only the two Vite HMR debug lines below. `pnpm shot` serves a production build via `vite preview`, so those lines never appear there; the entries are kept as harmless documentation (they are type 'debug', which is never checked). Uncaught page errors always fail and cannot be allowlisted; one-off expected errors go through `--allow-console-error "<substring>[:count]"` instead.

allow.justification: Vite HMR client banner; only emitted by the dev server, absent from production builds.
